name: const unsafe fn as_mut_vec (& mut self) -> & mut Vec < u8 >
rule: The bytes in the `String` must be valid UTF-8 when the mutable `Vec<u8>` reference returned by `as_mut_vec` is dropped and before the original `String` is used again.
api: impl  alloc::string::String { const unsafe fn as_mut_vec (& mut self) -> & mut alloc::vec::Vec < u8 > }
expression: The supplied DSL cannot express UTF-8 validity at future drop and reuse events.
